=== Lead photograph (31 Oct 2026) ===
The lead is a crop of a Facebook photograph of David Shettlesworth holding a fish (facebook.com/dshettlesworth; photo/?fbid=2738129906198598). Identification: exact legal name already on the wiki plus membership in the Star Wars CCG Facebook group. Lives South Pascagoula, Mississippi; From Mobile, Alabama; Bravo 37 on the Decipher Squadron roster (Mobile, Al). The profile circular is a meme; dest the fish photograph instead. Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook profile screenshot with the fish tile visible. Identification stays on Talk.
